# Built In. Melbourne

Built In. Melbourne Pty Ltd is a registered building company based in Bayside Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. The business delivers high-spec architectural renovations and bespoke new builds across Melbourne's inner south-east. Every project is personally managed by Josh Coles — registered domestic builder, DB-U 45446 / CDB-U 58374 — from initial brief through to handover.

Built In. Melbourne is not a volume builder. The business operates with a deliberately small footprint: a select number of projects per year, each personally overseen by Josh Coles. There are no site supervisors or project managers between Josh and his clients. He is the single point of contact on every build.

## Services

- High-Spec Architectural Renovations: Large-scale renovations of established homes, from heritage-sensitive restorations that preserve period character to full contemporary transformations. Projects typically involve structural alterations, premium material selections, interior-designed finishes, and timelines of twelve to eighteen months from tender to handover.
- Bespoke Architectural New Builds: Ground-up custom homes with architect-led designs, high-spec interiors, and the same level of personal oversight that defines every Built In. project. Josh Coles manages the complete build from tender through to handover, with weekly client communication and direct coordination with the design team throughout.
- Client-Side Project Management: Independent oversight for homeowners navigating complex builds with another contractor. Josh acts as a qualified advocate — reviewing documentation, attending site meetings, assessing workmanship at critical construction stages, and advising on compliance with approved plans and Australian building standards.

## Service Areas

Brighton, Elsternwick, Beaumaris, Caulfield, Hampton, Sandringham, Black Rock, Mentone, Cheltenham, Highett, Bentleigh, McKinnon, Ormond, Murrumbeena, Carnegie, Balaclava, Hawthorn, Surrey Hills, Malvern, Toorak, South Yarra, Armadale

Built In. Melbourne is open to well-suited projects outside these areas.

## Selected Projects

- Sir Garnet Road, Surrey Hills: Bespoke two-storey architectural new build. Dark vertical cladding, curved timber batten upper-level facade, white brick base, black steel pergola. Interior: white fluted cabinetry, curved stone benchtop island, walnut full-height pantry wall, polished concrete floors, feature staircase with full-height timber batten screen. Dark blue mosaic pool with glass fencing.
- Hawsleigh Avenue, Balaclava: Heritage-sensitive renovation. Original brick facade retained. Rear transformed: vaulted VJ-panelled ceilings, full-height black-framed bifold doors, custom oak joinery, encaustic tiles, matte black tapware. Bespoke detached garden studio in dark cladding with sliding glass doors.
- Liddiard Street, Hawthorn: Architectural renovation. Kitchen: dark grey cabinetry, garden window splashback, concealed walnut butler's pantry with coffee station. Bathroom: black freestanding bath, brass wall-mount tapware, custom oak vanity, dark hexagonal floor tiles. Heritage cornices retained throughout.
- Murrumbeena: Comprehensive interior renovation across kitchen, bathrooms, laundry, and mudroom. Consistent palette: navy shaker cabinetry, marble slab island and splashback, brass hardware. Freestanding bath on marble checkerboard tiles. Custom mudroom with built-in bench seating.
- The Fawkner Residence: Heritage-sensitive renovation. One original wall retained within heritage overlay. Coastal modern direction. Velux skylights throughout. Premium stone and tiling by Bowings.
- The Mary Residence: Full-scale renovation — modern aesthetic, clean lines, considered material selections.
- The Henry Residence: Contemporary renovation — refined modern direction, designed for how the homeowners live.

## Approach

Josh Coles prefers to be brought in before the tender package is finalised. At the preliminary design stage, his input on buildability, structural sequencing, and material lead times helps design teams avoid decisions that create unnecessary cost or complexity on site. Built In. Melbourne uses a staged tendering process: preliminary costing, a detailed scope, and a final fixed-price tender.

Quality comes from being present. Not from monitoring dashboards or reading supervisor reports — from standing on the slab, seeing the work, and holding the standard personally.
